prompt: The woman in the black polo-neck stays seated, the tablet resting on her knee, the camera nearly still. She lets her eyes drop to the dark screen of the tablet for a moment, idly, then lifts her gaze back up towards the man on the floor beside the camera, her face returning to the same angle and size as at the start, expression flat and bored. She says: I'm out. She holds the bored look afterwards, the factory windows glowing behind her. Sound: her cool, flat female voice, close, over the quiet room tone of a big brick loft.
